g.text: 1- Vehicles should be able to update their location

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2- Vehicles should be able to update their status (idle, on-way, in-use, etc.)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3- Users should be able to create accounts

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4- Users should be able to input start and destination locations and receive an estimate time and fare

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 5- Users should be able to get matched with the closest vehicle

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 6- Vehicles should be able to receive moving signals given a destination location

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 7- Users should be able to get notified with the arrival of the vehicle at the destination location

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 8- Users should be able to send an order to start the trip

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 9- Users should be able to send an arrival confirmation to end the trip

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 10- Users should be able to complete their payments

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 11- Users should be able to rate trips
